normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the beautiful NatureWalk community- Community amenities- 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes provided- Professionally decorated- Fully equipped kitchen- Pet-friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: A Peace of Gold is a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom house located in the Nature Walk community of Seagrove Beach that sleeps 8. With access to the Gathering Place, guests will love the zero-entry pool, playground, beach chair service by 3rd party, and more!Step up to the screened-in entryway with outdoor seating before entering this 2-story home with an open layout. The first-floor great room blends the dining, kitchen, and primary living areas together with splashes of blue and vibrant beach-themed artwork. With 2 matching sofas and 2 armchairs, this welcoming space is perfect for unwinding and relaxing. The adjacent kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a kitchen island with a built-in sink. Host friends and family at the 10-seat dining table to play board games or share a meal. For convenience, there is 1 primary bedroom located on this floor with a private bathroom and a full-sized washer and dryer.Upstairs is an additional living area with a queen sleeper sofa and 2 ottomans with a TV for entertainment. The remaining bedrooms can also be found on the second floor—1 guest bedroom, 1 bunk room with twin-over-twin beds, and 1 primary bedroom with access to a private balcony with gorgeous lake views. Stunning!A Peace of Gold is an incredible Florida retreat! For fun in the sun, follow Lilly Lane Beach Trail to San Juan Avenue, then head south to Santa Clara Regional Beach Access on the 4 adult bikes or 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub combo- Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Full Sleeper Sofa*RVs, boats, and/or trailers of any kind are not permitted in the neighborhood and will be towed at your expense.*Fireplace is not for guest use.**Please note that in order to utilize the Low-Speed Vehicle that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.*Please note that The Gathering Place will be closed for a major pool resurfacing project from Monday, January 27th, to the end of February. Owner badge access will be turned off, and closure notices will be posted on both gate accesses.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.

With access to the Gathering Place, guests will love the zero-entry pool, playground, beach chair service by 3rd party, and more! Step up to the screened-in entryway with outdoor seating before entering this 2-story home with an open layout. The first-floor great room blends the dining, kitchen, and primary living areas together with splashes of blue and vibrant beach-themed artwork. With 2 matching sofas and 2 armchairs, this welcoming space is perfect for unwinding and relaxing. The adjacent kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a kitchen island with a built-in sink. Host friends and family at the 10-seat dining table to play board games or share a meal. For convenience, there is 1 primary bedroom located on this floor with a private bathroom and a full-sized washer and dryer. Upstairs is an additional living area with a queen sleeper sofa and 2 ottomans with a TV for entertainment. The remaining bedrooms can also be found on the second floor—1 guest bedroom, 1 bunk room with twin-over-twin beds, and 1 primary bedroom with access to a private balcony with gorgeous lake views. Stunning! A Peace of Gold is an incredible Florida retreat! For fun in the sun, follow Lilly Lane Beach Trail to San Juan Avenue, then head south to Santa Clara Regional Beach Access on the 4 adult bikes or 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. Book now! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10): FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - Half Bathroom: Toilet Only SECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub combo - Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo - Additional Living Area: Full Sleeper Sofa *RVs, boats, and/or trailers of any kind are not permitted in the neighborhood and will be towed at your expense. *Fireplace is not for guest use. **Please note that in order to utilize the Low-Speed Vehicle that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts. *Please note that The Gathering Place will be closed for a major pool resurfacing project from Monday, January 27th, to the end of February. Owner badge access will be turned off, and closure notices will be posted on both gate accesses. *We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
